name: Balloons
note: Lift and reduced gravity prevent a fall while balloons remain attached.

name: Bouncer
note: The placed bouncer launches players and vehicles; the launch grants fall protection.

name: Chiller Grenade
note: The impact displaces players and gives icy feet; it does not cancel fall damage.

name: Crash Pad
note: Landing on the deployed pad launches the player safely; opponents can also be bounced.

name: Crash Pad Jr.
note: The small pad launches players on contact without landing damage.

name: Flint-Knock Pistol
note: An uncrouched shot displaces both the user and the target.

name: The Dub
note: The article explicitly identifies The Dub as sharing the pistol’s knockback behavior.

name: Grapple Blade
note: A connected grapple grants protection through the following landing; grounded attacks displace targets.

name: Grappler
note: A successful surface connection protects the following landing; missed shots are not protected.

name: Hop Rock
note: Its low-gravity effect prevents landing damage while active.

name: Impulse Grenade
note: Its blast launches players but does not grant fall protection.

name: Jetpack
note: Thrust provides flight while fueled; fuel loss can still cause landing damage.

name: Jump Pad (Directional)
note: The original directional floor trap launches players horizontally with fall protection.

name: Kinetic Blade
note: The second slash displaces an enemy; the user’s dash cancels falling damage.

name: Launch Pad
note: The launch returns a player to skydiving and permits glider deployment.

name: Mechanical Shockwave Bow
note: The charged projectile applies shockwave displacement with fall protection.

name: Nimbus Cloud (Kintoun)
note: Activation breaks colliding structures and opens a cloud glide; cancelling the glide is safe.

name: Pepper Mint
note: Consumption grants a temporary movement-speed increase.

name: Rift-To-Go
note: Activation teleports the user into the sky with glider deployment.

name: Rift Fish
note: Consumption produces the same functional rift as a Rift-To-Go.

name: Rocket Ram
note: Thrust and landing can break structures; it is also a traversal tool.

name: Shadow Stone
note: Shadow form grants invisibility, faster movement and protected falls only while the form remains active.

name: Shockwave Grenade
note: The shockwave protects displaced players; a player propelled through a build breaks that build.

name: Shockwave Hammer
note: The slam breaks builds and displaces opponents; its bounce protects the user’s landing.

name: Sideways Scythe
note: Swings damage builds; its leap gained landing protection after the original unsafe implementation.

name: Silver Surfer’s Board
note: Activation opens a surfboard glide, and cancelling early does not cause landing damage.

name: Spicy Fish
note: Consumption grants a temporary speed effect.

name: Airbending
note: Air Wheel has a sprint boost; Air Jump also launches nearby opponents.

name: War Machine’s Hover Jets
note: The jets provide sustained powered flight; sprinting accelerates it while consuming more fuel.

name: Wings of Icarus
note: Holding the wings protects falls; the dive bomb damages builds and displaces enemies.

name: Witch Broom
note: The upward burst breaks intersecting builds and opens a cancellable safe glide.

name: Slurp Barrel
note: Destroying a normal barrel near the player restores effective health. Quest-only inert barrels do not qualify.

name: Zipline
note: Attaching and dismounting cancels falling damage.

name: Ascender
note: Vertical transport protects falls until landing and can clear a blocking structure.

name: Geyser
note: A vent burst launches the player and permits a glider.

name: Slipstream
note: The wind tunnel transports players; exiting permits glider deployment.

name: Grind Rail
note: Grinding provides transport along the rail and allows faster grinding through sprint input.

name: Kinetic Ore
note: A struck rock launches and can carry a player standing on it.
